_about: Institutional risk policy. Thresholds recovered from the dataset's labelling policy by evaluation/policy_tree.py (depth-3 decision tree, 99.7% accuracy). The policy only escalates the model's label, never downgrades it.

rules.label: Dropout-Likely
rules.reason: CGPA ({CGPA}) and last term's SGPA ({Previous_SGPA}) are both below {probation_cgpa}: two consecutive low terms.

rules.label: Dropout-Likely
rules.reason: Attendance ({Attendance_Percentage}%) is below the {severe_attendance_pct}% severe-absence limit.

rules.label: At-Risk
rules.reason: CGPA ({CGPA}) is below the {at_risk_cgpa} good-standing threshold.

rules.label: At-Risk
rules.reason: Attendance ({Attendance_Percentage}%) is below the {min_attendance_pct}% minimum requirement.
